Bill.BriefDescription: Prescribing guidelines for contracts for telecommunications services in correctional institutions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to contracts for telecommunications services incorrectional institutions; and adding a new section to chapter 72.09RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 72.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A contract to provide inmates with access to telecommunicationsservices in a facility operated by the department may not include acommission or other payment to the department based upon amounts billedby the telecommunications provider for telephone calls made by inmatesin the facility. (2) This section does not apply to any contract in effect on theeffective date of this act, but does apply to any renegotiation,renewal, or extension of such a contract.
